snippet.title: Jungle Man | Launch Trailer (Meta Quest)
snippet.description:
Available now on Meta Quest 3 – get Jungle Man here:
https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/jungle-man/8089151204431223/

There is no other mixed reality game like this.  Jungle Man is a wild, hand-tracked platformer built exclusively for Quest 3 and 3s. With over 70 handcrafted levels, full-room movement, and no controllers required, Jungle Man transforms your real-world space into a chaotic, hilarious, and surprisingly difficult jungle adventure.

- 70+ levels of swinging, dodging, and dying
- Free Swing Mode unlocks after completing the game
- Designed for hand tracking and full-room play
- Built only for Meta Quest 3
- play inside OR outside

Think you can beat it without dying? Fun Train is offering $1,000 to each of the first FIVE players who complete the game with zero deaths. The No-Death Challenge is live now and more info can be found at http://www.funtrainvr.com/contest

Developed by Fortell Games & Megaverse LLC
Published by Fun Train
